declare @s nvarchar(128), @l int, @size int, @i int, @delta int select top 0 identity(int, 1, 1) as id, stt_rec, cast('' as varchar(33)) as stt_rec0, cast('' as char(6)) as p into #tagRow from &FlowMultiGeneralTable; select @size = 0 select @i = 1, @l = datalength(text) from @k select @size = charindex(',', text, @size) from @k
while @size > 0 and @size < @l begin select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @size - @i), '''', '') from @k insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s) - 1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s))) select @i = @size + 1, @delta = charindex(',', substring(text, @size + 1, @l - @size)) from @k if @delta = 0 break
select @size = @size + @delta end if @i < @l begin select @s = replace(substring(text, @i, @l - @i), '''', '') from @k insert into #tagRow(stt_rec, stt_rec0) select left(@s, charindex(char(255), @s) - 1), right(@s, (len(@s) - charindex(char(255), @s))) end --update #tagRow set p = convert(char(6), b.ngay_ct, 112) from #tagRow a join &FlowMultiGeneralTable; b on b.stt_rec = a.stt_rec
declare @p char(6), @r nvarchar(4000), @q nvarchar(4000)
select tr.id, stt_rec0 as ma_vv, b.ten_vv%l as ten_vv, b.dien_tich_dat, b.dien_tich_xay_dung_toi_da, b.dien_tich_xay_dung, b.gia_mua * 0 as gia_ban_vv into #d from #tagRow tr left join dmvv b on tr.stt_rec0 = b.ma_vv
update #d set gia_ban_vv = b.tong_cong from #d a join (select row_number() over(partition by ma_vv order by ngay_hl desc) as ln, * from zgiabansp) b on a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and b.ln = 1 select '' as array$, id, &OtherCopyField; from #d &FlowMultiOrderBy; return
